inputs_required: sensor calibration and full covariance or explicit unknown
held-out run and sampling transfer function

algorithm_steps: Admit raw signals with verified transformations, coordinate frames and clock mappings; unresolved data are rejected, not imputed
Construct exact SO(3) nominal and error motion, compose sensor transfer functions and optical forward operator at original requested fidelity
Enumerate topology/contact hypotheses only when supported; fix gauge or impose independent datum, never silently pin a real error to zero
Whiten joint residuals with measured correlated covariance; retain explicit nuisance calibrations; inspect local scaled SVD and global alternative hypotheses
Solve constrained likelihood or robust documented error model with analytic/AD pose derivatives and validated event derivatives; separate sensor saturation and outliers via predeclared rules
Evaluate profile likelihood or bounded feasible sets along weak and null directions; state when priors rather than data bound a parameter
Cross-check independent starts, alternate admissible harmonic truncations and covariance models; reserve other runs, phase windows, speeds and remounts as holdouts
For deposition residuals: perform independent time, source, event geometry and substrate refinement using T02 statuses; mechanical fit is not evidence these axes converged
Propagate joint correlated uncertainty with declared distributions or bounds; no independent Gaussian substitution for unknown systematic errors
Freeze raw identity, transforms, model, residuals, null vectors, uncertainty evidence and held-out prediction checks; stop on predeclared budget and report unresolved

formal_accuracy.reason: physical tolerances and data not supplied; no reduced precision is selected
independent_axes: statistical Monte Carlo error when applicable
